messages.subject: Re: NBLAST online crashing
parts:
Dear Tim,

Thanks for your request. This crash was the result of an autoupdate applied by our IT to the server running NBLAST – regrettably I have had a great deal of difficulty rolling back those changes.

However there is now some good news on this. Rob Court at Edinburgh has been able to set up the same service on a server that he runs, which should be appreciably more powerful than our previous one.

Please therefore go to:

http://nblast.virtualflybrain.org:8080/NBLAST_on-the-fly/

and try it out!

Best,

Greg.


PS I have taken the liberty of ccing this message to the nat-user google group since the answer will likely be of interest to others.

On 26 Apr 2018, at 16:15, Timothy Wiggin wrote:

Hi Greg, I'm getting a javascript error on the NBLAST on-the-fly site:


I'm attaching the log file. I wish I could say I understand what the error is, but javascript logs are verbose as all get out and I can't follow.

Also, since I'm emailing you anyway, I love NBLAST and it's totally changed how I approach finding Gal4 drivers. Thanks for making it available!

Tim
